# Purpose

Last verified: August 20, 2026

This repository contains the first static design draft for the German
“Schwimmteich für Dich” website. It demonstrates the information architecture
and visual direction for swimming ponds, natural pools, bathing ponds, and
custom water projects.

The website is not yet a publication-ready company website. Text, prices,
images, technical details, contact information, and legal content remain
placeholders until they receive professional and legal approval. The historical
analysis of the previous website in
[`../../OLD_SITE_ANALYSIS.md`](../../OLD_SITE_ANALYSIS.md) is research material,
not approved publication content.

The binding project decisions for this draft are documented in
[`../../.codex/context/`](../../.codex/context/README.md).
